plan: Bid slightly below my value to maximize profit if I win while avoiding overbidding. Assume others will bid rationally, likely below their own values. Aim to win if second-highest bid is significantly lower than my value. Bid $21 to balance potential gain against risk of overpaying.
Bid slightly above half my value to ensure potential profit while minimizing loss. Assume others bid near their value. Bid $8.1 to maximize earnings if winning and limit risk if losing.
